split.family_held_meaning: New whole-program variants within the familiar positive physical-parent-stat family; NOT unseen numeric-stat-family transfer.
split.source_grouping: All aliases/reprints of one full normalized program stay together. LAW full own/opponent aspect factorial TRAIN at victimdamage2; both own truths STATE-held at damage3. Fresh state transfer remains distinct from unsupported fresh aspect-numeric program transfer.

template_gate.aspect_numeric_new_program_gate: UNSUPPORTED: LAW045 is the only aspect-dependent numeric-damage template among actual115; report fresh STATE transfer separately.

numeric_support_prelabel.interpretation: Expected native quantities only. Held HP2 interpolates the TRAIN1/3 range; HP3 and P2 appear in TRAIN. Actual observed support is a mandatory postcollection gate, not an oracle label.

raw_abi.capture: Full native state and current public projections with known flags and complete printed metadata; BEFORE only is model input.
raw_abi.declaration: refs,declared_intent{ref,id,requires_target},observation_refs; aura uses source play-intent and has no external intended-target bit.
raw_abi.physical_proof: fixtureAttachmentWitnesses list; actual targetAction and final source parent are label proof only.
raw_abi.task: Observe both predeclared public endpoints under ONE actual action. Old conditional-on-query labels remain valid and are a separate secondary panel.

privacy: Only own known source hand and public arena/resources/base/leader. Both decks and opponent hand empty; no attacks, draws, private order or future links in inputs.
novelty: LAW victimHP10/damage2 differs from seen16 HP7/damage0/1. Prior programs/states are diagnostics, never fresh qualification. Native inputs must be audited against saved old banks without outcome-based replacement.
